messages:
Jordan (AM): heads up — execs at Meridian want a quick sync. their board asked for final SLA language, KMS attest, and a clear POC runway by Friday EOD. can we get a one-pager + action owners?
Priya (Solutions): I can draft the POC runbook today. need answers on throughput targets and whether they want prefix caching enabled.
Hector (SE): throughput they mentioned was 500 reqs/s with avg 64 tokens. caching should be fine but may need dedicated pool to hit 99th pct latency.
Riley (AE): fyi pricing question: customer asked for a committed discount if they sign reserved capacity. legal wants a draft of the commitment term.
Lina (Legal): I saw the vendor questionnaire. high priority items: data residency clause, indemnity cap, and KMS key management responsibilities. I'll prepare redlines.
Jordan (AM): thanks. can we get a prioritized list? Celine is going to be on the call if we have something to show.
Priya (Solutions): priority list (short): 1) SLA & uptime targets 2) KMS attestation + who holds keys 3) Pricing model/commitment term 4) Network peering details 5) Security questionnaire responses
Hector (SE): running quick perf sim now. estimate: with Dedicated pool N=4 gpus + batching, median latency ~45ms, 99th ~210ms. if they want <150ms 99th we need N=6.
Riley (AE): rough committed pricing calc I told them: baseline hosted + 20% reserved discount. putting sketch here:
```
monthly_estimate = tokens_per_month * $0.00035 + reserved_gpu_hours * $X
if commit >= 6 months -> discount 15%
```
Jordan (AM): Lina, can you confirm whether we can accept a 12-month minimum commitment in the contract? customer prefers shorter but execs want runway.
Lina (Legal): 12 months is standard for Reserved. we can do 6 months with higher pricing. will add fallback language for early termination fees.
ops-bot: task created -> #ticket-9821 "Meridian POC: SLA/KMS/Contract" assigned to Priya, Hector, Lina. due: 2026-03-27 17:00 UTC
Priya (Solutions): sharing draft runbook link: https://rz.redwood.internal/meridian/poc-runbook (will update with perf numbers)
Hector (SE): uploaded perf matrix and config suggestions to the doc. note: enable prefix caching + kv-cache TTL=24h reduces token cost by ~12%.
Riley (AE): I emailed the customer execs asking for final accept of throughput targets and whether they require BYO KMS. awaiting reply.
Celine (VP Sales): thanks team — assemble a one-pager (1 slide) summarizing ask, blockers, and decision needed from our execs. Jordan, can you run a 20m prep before the call at 16:00 PT?
Jordan (AM): yes I'll run the prep 15:30 PT. Lina, bring the contract highlights. Hector, bring the perf slide. Priya, bring the runbook summary. Riley, bring the pricing slide.
Lina (Legal): will bring redlines and the option matrix (6 vs 12 month).
Priya (Solutions): will have the runbook + candidate config options by 15:00 PT.
Riley (AE): update: customer replied, they prefer BYO KMS and want a 6-month pilot. depositing that into the doc now.
Jordan (AM): great. last thing — we need an exec signoff path if they push earlier than EOD. Celine, are you ok to be the sign off until legal finalizes redlines?
Celine (VP Sales): I can sign off on the commercial terms only if Legal flags nothing material. I'll join the prep call. :thumbsup:
Jordan (AM): perfect. tracking status: doc draft in progress, perf sims done, legal redlines pending, customer confirmed BYO KMS + 6-month pilot. next checkpoint: 15:30 PT prep.
Hector (SE): quick note — if they BYO KMS we need a connectivity run in the POC week 1. ops team will need network schedule.
Priya (Solutions): adding a week-1 checklist item for KMS key exchange and test harness (will include sample curl).
Riley (AE): pinging customer for availability for Thursday boardroom slot. will update.
Jordan (AM): thanks everyone. mark any risks inline in the doc. if anything blocks the prep call ping me with @jordan. :rocket:
